item.title: Why Lord of the Mysteries Broke Every Rule of Its Genre
item.description:
Instead of winning through brute talent, Klein Moretti survives twenty-two sanity-crushing potion pathways by bluffing secret demi-gods from behind a wall of gray fog. Here is the complete animated breakdown of Lord of the Mysteries — the hidden rules, character psychology, biggest twists, and our honest verdict.
